name: invalid_bind_group_dynamic_binding_missing_range
description: CreateBindGroup omits the explicit buffer range for a binding declared dynamic by the bind-group layout.
reason: Dynamic buffer bindings must declare a concrete base offset and size so SetBindGroup can apply dynamic_offsets against a bounded buffer range.
fix: Provide both offset and size on every CreateBindGroup entry whose layout binding has has_dynamic_offset set to true.
